items.title: I've joined Anthropic
items.whyItMatters: Karpathy at Anthropic is a direct signal about where serious alignment-focused engineering talent is concentrating — worth tracking.

items.title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
items.whyItMatters: Concrete evidence of LLMs doing novel mathematical discovery, not just pattern-matching — the bar just moved for what 'reasoning' means.

items.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
items.whyItMatters: A 46-point accuracy lift from structured guardrails alone on an 8B model — directly applicable to anyone building agents on smaller open-weights models.

items.title: GitHub confirms breach of 3,800 repos via malicious VSCode extension
items.whyItMatters: Extension marketplace supply-chain attacks are the new dependency confusion — audit your installed extensions if you use VSCode in CI or shared environments.

items.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash: frontier intelligence with action
items.whyItMatters: Google's fastest-tier model now has native tool-use and long context baked in — raises the floor for what 'cheap API call' can do in production agentic pipelines.
